# superset_database_schemas (Data Source)

Lists the schemas Superset sees in a database connection, for example to create a dataset for every table of a schema that exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_database_schemas" "warehouse" {
  database_name = "Warehouse"
}

output "schemas" {
  value = data.superset_database_schemas.warehouse.schemas
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_name` (String) Name of the database connection.

### Optional

- `catalog` (String) Name of the catalog whose schemas are listed, on Superset 6 for connections with several catalogs; older versions ignore it. When unset, the default catalog of the connection.

### Read-Only

- `database_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the connection.
- `schemas` (List of String) Names of the schemas, sorted.
